system.description:
Favoured weapon: Crossbow, Light

Granted power: Advantage on checks to appraise, bargain or spot a forgery, and on saves against charm.

  • Your Smite deals double its radiant damage to a creature that has broken its word to you or an ally. 9th level: when you look at a creature, you know if it has broken a sworn oath or a contract in the last 30 days, though not which.
  • Magic that hides thoughts or alignment hides this too.
  • This sense does not trigger your Smite's double damage.

Allegiance: Lawful Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Abadar in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: keep one sworn contract or charter until its term ends (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
